title: ABSeeker: Training Long-Horizon Search Agents via Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment
title_zh: ABSeeker：通过答案回溯信用分配训练长程搜索智能体
abstract_en: Long-horizon search agents must make multiple sequential actions (steps) to search, retrieve, verify, and integrate evidence to reach a final answer. However, existing methods for training these agents typically treat all steps within a trajectory uniformly during both supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), failing to distinguish useful actions from erroneous or redundant ones. In this paper, we propose Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment (ABC), a fine-grained credit assignment framework for training long-horizon search agents by converting sparse trajectory-level outcomes into dense step-level supervision that rewards useful actions (even in failed trajectories) while suppressing erroneous or redundant actions. Specifically, given a potentially obscure query and its corresponding ground-truth answer, ABC first performs Answer-Backtracked Clue Recovery, which traces back from the answer to recover intermediate clues required to solve the question. It then applies Clue-Anchored Step Scoring to evaluate each search step against these clues, converting sparse binary outcome supervision into dense step-level rewards. Based on these rewards, we develop ABC-SFT, which reweights the loss of each turn, and ABC-GRPO, which uses the step-level scores as rewards in GRPO. Building on this framework, we train ABSeeker based on Qwen3.5-4B with only 8.5k examples. ABSeeker achieves 37.3% on BrowseComp and 39.1% on BrowseComp-ZH. With context management, the scores further improve to 55.3% and 52.9%, respectively, significantly outperforming same-scale (4B) agents and even matching the performance of larger ones (approximately 30B). These results demonstrate the effectiveness of answer-backtracked step-level credit assignment for training long-horizon search agents.
abstract_zh: 长程搜索智能体需要通过多步连续行动完成搜索、检索、验证与证据整合，最终得到答案。然而，现有训练方法在监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）中通常对轨迹内所有步骤一视同仁，难以区分有效动作、错误动作与冗余动作。本文提出 Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment（ABC），一种细粒度信用分配框架，可将稀疏的轨迹级结果转化为密集的步骤级监督：奖励有用动作（即使它们出现在失败轨迹中），同时抑制错误或冗余动作。具体而言，ABC 首先通过 Answer-Backtracked Clue Recovery 从标准答案反向恢复解题所需的中间线索；随后使用 Clue-Anchored Step Scoring 将每个搜索步骤与这些线索对齐并打分，从而把二值结果监督转化为步骤级奖励。在此基础上，作者提出 ABC-SFT，对每轮损失进行重加权；以及 ABC-GRPO，将步骤级分数作为 GRPO 的奖励信号。基于 Qwen3.5-4B，作者仅用 8.5k 样本训练得到 ABSeeker。该模型在 BrowseComp 和 BrowseComp-ZH 上分别达到 37.3% 和 39.1%；结合上下文管理后进一步提升至 55.3% 和 52.9%，显著优于同规模（4B）智能体，并接近约 30B 级模型表现。结果表明，基于答案回溯的步骤级信用分配对训练长程搜索智能体非常有效。
key_points_zh: 提出 Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment（ABC），将最终答案级稀疏监督转化为搜索过程中的细粒度步骤级奖励。
ABC 通过 Answer-Backtracked Clue Recovery 从 ground-truth answer 反向恢复关键线索，再用 Clue-Anchored Step Scoring 评估每一步搜索动作的价值。
基于 ABC 设计 ABC-SFT 和 ABC-GRPO：前者按步骤质量重加权 SFT 损失，后者将步骤级分数作为 GRPO 强化学习奖励。
ABSeeker 基于 Qwen3.5-4B、仅使用 8.5k 样本训练，在 BrowseComp / BrowseComp-ZH 上达到 37.3% / 39.1%。
加入上下文管理后，ABSeeker 提升至 55.3% / 52.9%，超过同规模 4B 智能体，并接近约 30B 模型表现。

llm_assessment.comment: Strong search-agent training work that introduces answer-backtracked step-level credit assignment for long-horizon search trajectories.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇很强的搜索智能体训练论文，提出了面向长程搜索轨迹的答案回溯式步骤级信用分配。
